name: vs-b-settings-admin
caption: Own speech chosen; the OpenAI key for GPT-Live set by a person on a date; four cards: Engine, Machine, Models, Behaviour.

name: vs-b-settings-key-link
caption: The Engine card with the OpenAI key's one-time link open: time left, the whole link, Copy link and Open.

name: vs-b-settings-key-unset
caption: No OpenAI key yet: the key shows Not set and the button to add one.

name: vs-b-settings-pending
caption: A bigger machine saved: the Machine card says once, in its band, that it changes at the next start, with Undo.

name: vs-b-settings-applied
caption: The saved machine is now in use: the Machine card shows Applied and the start it happened at.

name: vs-b-settings-fetching
caption: A session is starting and the new speech-to-text model is being fetched: the Models card shows its download.

name: vs-b-settings-refused
caption: The server refused the picked machine: the Machine card names the field and the value, with a button to reload the catalogue.

name: vs-b-settings-conflict
caption: Someone else saved first: the head shows their version and the Models card shows who, when and their value, with Use theirs and Save mine over it.

name: vs-b-settings-stockout
caption: The last start found no free L4 in the zone: the Machine card says so and that the session opened in text mode.

name: vs-b-settings-error
caption: The settings could not be read: one failure line with Retry, and no cards drawn from guesses.

name: vs-b-settings-readonly
caption: A person who is not a platform admin: the same cards with values only, no controls, a Read only mark.

name: vs-b-telemetry-live-idle
caption: No session running: the stopped line, the last 30 days as a strip, then every session.

name: vs-b-telemetry-live-starting
caption: A session starting: its phases fill the track towards the four-minute limit.

name: vs-b-telemetry-live-session
caption: A session running: latency per utterance with its p90, then GPU, GPU memory, CPU, memory and disk.

name: vs-b-telemetry-sessions
caption: The last 90 days, scrolled to the long list of sessions, each with its latency and GPU lines, machine minutes and cost.

name: vs-b-telemetry-session-detail
caption: One session opened: its start phases, latency percentiles, peaks, machine and talking minutes, cost and crashes.

name: vs-b-telemetry-days
caption: One day picked on the strip: the list shows only its sessions and its totals in the head.

name: vs-b-telemetry-empty
caption: No sessions yet: no charts, only Start talking.

name: vs-b-telemetry-error
caption: Telemetry could not be read: one failure line with Retry, never an empty or zero timeline.

name: vs-b-settings-admin-390
caption: Settings on a phone: the cards stacked, each machine's size under its name.

name: vs-b-telemetry-live-session-390
caption: A running session on a phone: the two latency charts stacked, the readings two to a row.
